description: Implementation reuse after the immutable initial baseline. This record does not advance verified package support.

adaptations: Native palette types, defaults and augmentation; browser colorSpace is not implemented.
Zero object tonal offsets are supported rather than producing upstream NaN channels.
Typed standalone helpers without Babel or MUI runtime dependencies.
String input signatures follow declarations; undocumented object overloads are not supported.
recomposeColor leaves input channels unmodified.
Diagnostic wording identifies MUI Native.
Typed standalone spacing transformation; native diagnostics identify unsupported array indices.
Typed standalone breakpoint helpers and augmentation interfaces.
Native width-query evaluation and style normalization follow the upstream breakpoint rule ordering.
No DOM, CSS engine, arbitrary media query or container-query implementation is included.
Typography tokens expand as CSS rules; native font units are normalized after the complete style cascade.
Public typography values and augmentation interfaces follow the pinned MUI contract. Native unit and font-family conversion happens separately at the rendering boundary.
Typography defaults, variant mapping, color names and override ordering use native Text and accessibility semantics instead of DOM/CSS rendering.
Native style and text inheritance are platform extensions; browser elements, CSS classes and DOM refs are not rendered.
Typed native default resolution and deferred callbacks; native style arrays/callbacks preserve React Native semantics under the opt-in merge flag.
Own special keys are defined as data properties without changing object prototypes.
Native theme/default contexts and legacy/raw configuration selection; no browser styling context is imported.
Native style arrays/callbacks are composed rather than spread as CSS objects.
Absent callback results and absent default objects resolve safely to empty props.
Native event-key detection uses the same uppercase onX convention.
Native TextField slots preserve the input-container/editable-host distinction with native refs, styles, owner state and event adaptation.
The native adapter is a composable extension, not an InputBase/OutlinedInput/FilledInput parity claim. Disabled/read-only guards remain authoritative.
Native generic ref types and React 19 callback cleanup returns.
Attachment-local idempotent cleanup, variable-length ref lists, error rollback and complete release after cleanup errors.
Shared native input engine for the base/standard/filled/outlined controls, native adornments and measured outline gaps.
Native refs/events/styles and content-size row bounds replace DOM inputs, fieldsets, pseudo-elements and textarea measurement.
TextField retains its documented native host-value guard and native callback order through a private bridge.
Native label/helper associations, focus registration and focused placeholder visibility are coordinated through the form context.
Shared native form state and optional useFormControl lookup.
Native form state callbacks coordinate focus, filled and adorned-start state with stable provider values.
Native label/helper state, typography and variant-specific floating offsets replace browser label elements and CSS transitions.
Native transforms request the native animation driver; shared reduced-motion monitoring handles late results and releases subscriptions.
Long-label width expands after shrink completion instead of animating CSS max-width on every frame. Native label focus and naming use the surrounding form registry.
Native control refs/events replace DOM refs/events; helper field variants and reserved blank lines follow the pinned component contracts.

One shared native theme context replaces the browser styling/private-engine pair. Object nesting shallow-merges top-level keys; callbacks replace the selected theme and are evaluated once per memoized resolution, rather than separately for two browser engines.

Generic System themeId scopes preserve the surrounding theme envelope; empty-context fallbacks, component defaults and direction follow the selected scope. Native style helpers select an optional scope without installing a CSS engine.
A native React context preserves the provider and hook boolean defaults. It does not change global I18nManager settings or establish physical RTL layout.
Material ThemeProvider and hooks select the public $$material scope. Native Material, icon and X renderers consume scoped tokens and styles; System hooks retain the raw envelope.
The no-vars object marker is retained. CSS variable generation, browser storage and color-scheme providers remain unsupported; native transforms/styles do not introduce DOM layers.

Native Modal windows and inline native Views replace DOM portals, root/backdrop nodes and browser focus handling. Native root/backdrop refs, controlled dismissal reasons, slots and transition wiring follow the selected pinned contracts.

Native stack ownership guards dismissal and deferred focus work. Text-input capture, explicit native focus refs and public native-node containment replace browser activeElement queries. Full tab trapping, DOM containers, scroll locking and CSS transitions remain unfinished.

Inline keepMounted preserves state. React Native window dismissal unmounts children and emits a usage diagnostic when keepMounted is requested; native window presentation and screen readers still require device validation.
A native stack replaces DOM containers, sibling aria mutation and body scroll locking. Ancestor ordering handles child-first React layout registration.

Deferred restoration follows top focus ownership; unrelated background removals preserve restoration, while a new top owner invalidates it. Native-window and inline rendering retain explicit physical accessibility and focus-validation gates.

Dialog composes the reusable native Modal with keyboard avoidance, native paper sizing and four implemented native slots. Root props and conflicting root-slot precedence follow pinned Dialog routing; paper props are explicit slots.

The keyboard container forwards its public native view ref and lets background touches reach the backdrop. Native styles/events replace CSS classes, DOM roles and browser transitions; complete Dialog contracts remain open.
Typed theme duration/easing, CSS timing generation, automatic-height calculation and reduced-motion configuration follow the pinned MIT algorithms. No browser animation engine is introduced.
Theme transition/motion initialization, additional-argument merging and removal of legacy transitions.reducedMotion follow the pinned configuration behavior.
A native lifecycle state machine adapts pinned appear/enter/exit, mount/unmount, callbacks and completion races. Native refs replace DOM nodes; TransitionGroup interoperation remains unfinished.
Private native measurement readiness defers enter without consuming the initial appear state and permits cleanup when closed before geometry resolves.
Native-driver opacity replaces CSS opacity transitions without adding a native wrapper. Native timing/style translation is bounded and diagnostic; timers remain the authored lifecycle fallback.
Public transition actions, timing and lifecycle names adapt pinned declarations to native View refs, styles and events. Browser DOM targets are excluded.
Backdrop root/transition slots and transitionDuration now compose a native Fade; native controlled open drives actual opacity exits.
Dialog composes the default Fade and transition slot with the native keyboard container; native-window animation defaults to none to avoid duplicate motion.
A shared native AccessibilityInfo resource replaces media-query preference observation. Unknown system state suppresses motion; native changes stop active owned motion promptly.

Native Text hosts replace DOM literal text and a shared React-only context carries inheritable text values through native containers. Native roots, refs, keys and single-element shape are preserved; browser inline flow remains unfinished.

Native text-only style routing distinguishes inherited font/decoration/shadow/direction fields from local layout and selection fields; CSS authored metric metadata and literal native lengths retain distinct semantics.
Paper follows the pinned text color reset and custom-root forwarding; container literal children use native text scopes without applying MuiTypography component defaults.
Typography consumes the shared native text context across View boundaries while leaving native Text inheritance active inside a tracked text parent.
Native window text scopes reset to native root defaults while inline overlays inherit their parent; backdrop content shares native text handling without changing root refs or dismissal wiring.

Grow height-based duration, split opacity/transform factory arguments, completion semantics and public auto marker follow the pinned MIT implementation. Native public clientHeight and node-keyed layout fallback replace DOM measurements.

A shared native-driver opacity/scale surface adapts selected Fade/Grow states without a native wrapper. Current cancellation settles the owned values; stale generations are ignored. Native child keys, refs, style ordering and reduced motion are preserved.
Private auto-duration getter support follows the pinned transition completion contract while retaining native timer/listener cancellation and callback ordering.
Private native measurement readiness defers enter without consuming the initial appear state and permits cleanup when closed before geometry resolves.

Native root/paper/transition/backdrop routing and public Popover contracts adapt the pinned MIT source. Native window/local coordinates, scrolling, content direction and measured readiness replace browser DOM infrastructure.
Anchor offsets, transform origins, rounding and viewport corrections follow original Popover, including its marginThreshold=null horizontal-right branch.
Pinned placement is coordinated through guarded asynchronous native measurements and actual node/cycle identity; stale results cannot position a reopened or replaced surface.

Native ButtonBase adapts pinned non-button activation ordering, disabled focus rules, action focus, theme state and native link ownership. Native ripple/opacity and a Fabric focus/key host replace browser DOM and programmable TouchRipple.
Native keyboard adapters retain the original non-button click/default-prevention ordering while exposing truthful native key payloads rather than a browser MouseEvent.
Native List context, padding, icon/avatar/subheader style contracts adapt the pinned MIT source. Owned ScrollView/sticky indices and fragment identity are native extensions.
Native ListItem root/secondary-action slots, density/gutters/divider and absolute logical-end action geometry adapt the pinned MIT source. Natural-size fitting excludes parent-dependent axes.
Primary fallback, dense Typography choices, truthy multiline state and three native slot contracts follow pinned source; native wrapping and ref types replace browser hosts.
Native ButtonBase composition, density/alignment, selected/disabled/hover/focus styling and autofocus follow pinned source with native touch-size and measured action-space adaptations.
Private density/alignment/gutter context adapts pinned ListContext; private action measurement/space extends native composition.

Registered native focus, keyboard traversal, 500 ms typeahead, initial focus and context follow pinned MUI contracts. Public connected native nodes replace DOM queries and activeElement. Native initial handoff retains keyboard focus indication.

Native ButtonBase composition, registered item metadata, selected/dense states and initial input source adapt pinned MenuItem. Native roles map checkable menu items to checkbox/radio accessibility semantics.
Private native registry and initial focus source replace DOM MenuList and Select focus contexts.
Connected native refs and compareDocumentPosition order replace DOM registration; finite bounded traversal handles empty and all-disabled lists.
React 19 ref cleanup uses attachment tokens and deferred removal to protect replacement native nodes.
Owning native menu navigation keys bypass disabled-focus prevention while activation remains guarded. The original ButtonBase currently omits passing focusableWhenDisabled into its hook.
Inherited native text color and fontSize=inherit plus menu icon density adapt SvgIcon inherited sizing and color; original icon paths remain independently authored.

Five native slots, initial focus policy, open/keepMounted guards, direction-based origins, entering order, Tab reasons and menu height reservation adapt pinned Menu; native readiness and observed focus replace browser window focus assumptions.
Default Menu slot and global-state identifiers follow generateUtilityClass. Browser ClassNameGenerator customization and CSS class styling are not implemented.
Native overlay readiness defers initial focus until presentation/placement/top ownership; nested native MenuLists isolate keyboard navigation and typeahead while preserving ancestor callbacks.
